purpose: Anchor the ontology in agents, perspectives, conceptual processes and their conceptual products.
description: The formation and articulation of an explicit, purpose-oriented account of a subject.

purpose: Explain why a conceptualization is undertaken and which goals and values guide selection.
description: The goal-directed orientation of agents and the content guiding their choices.

purpose: Connect concept formation with observation, experience, understanding and feedback.
description: Mental activities and states involved in attending to, interpreting and understanding a subject.

purpose: Explain selective simplification and distinguish concept descriptions, instance descriptions and their links.
description: The selection of relevant characteristics and organization of descriptions across levels of generality.

purpose: Connect representations to interpreted content and expose interpretive dependencies.
description: Meaning, interpretation and conditions for compatible understanding of representations.

purpose: Provide the relational vocabulary needed to form an integrated conceptual artifact.
description: Descriptions of connections and attributed characteristics among conceptual elements.

purpose: Distinguish conceptual content from its visual, schematic, presentational and temporal encodings.
description: Forms and conventions through which conceptual content is externally expressed.

purpose: Support explicit conceptual modeling, model views and reuse of representations.
description: Activities and artifacts that express selected aspects of a subject as structured models.

purpose: Make internal composition and structural organization explicit without assuming every link is composition.
description: Organization of conceptual elements, including part-whole descriptions.

purpose: Provide expression, syntax and communication mechanisms for conceptual articulation.
description: Systems and activities for expressing and communicating content through signs and rules.

purpose: Stabilize naming and definitions so concepts can be compared and communicated.
description: Terms, definitions and their systematic organization for a selected subject.

purpose: Explain model conformance and distinguish models, metamodels and models of models.
description: Models and activities that describe modeling constructs and classification levels.

purpose: Connect category formation and instance classification to concepts and generalization.
description: Formation, application and hierarchical organization of conceptual categories.

purpose: Make conceptual commitments precise enough to state and examine constraints.
description: Formal expression, adopted assertions and restrictions on admissible interpretations.

purpose: Add only Ontological Commitment to connect vocabulary with intended interpretation.
description: Explicit assumptions about the entities and relations admitted in a conceptual account.

purpose: Extend what can be conceptualized to states and changes, with temporal reference.
description: General categories of being, state, change and temporal organization relevant to a subject.

purpose: Add the relevant prior content through Domain Knowledge without importing knowledge management.
description: Articulable content about a subject that can inform understanding and conceptual choices.

purpose: Make quality expectations explicit as criterion specifications rather than ungrounded numeric scores.
description: Criteria for judging the semantic adequacy and internal integrity of conceptual artifacts.

purpose: Support assessment against explicit criteria, record findings, and connect review to feedback and revision.
description: Activities and explicit criteria used to examine conceptual artifacts.

purpose: Make conceptual choices and their justifications traceable, and distinguish evidence from provisional assumptions.
description: Origins, supporting information and assumptions associated with conceptual content.

purpose: Provide object, agent, content, event and type distinctions; this is not a separately selected subject domain.
description: A cross-domain support layer of general categories required for UFO-grounded typing.
